result.question: Who wanted people to serve him?

readings.support: If only this people were under my authority

assessments.reason: “Why should we serve Abimelech?” names Abimelech as the one being served, but it does not show his desire; the only expressed desire in the passage is Gaal’s.
“If only this people were under my authority” explicitly shows Gaal wanted the people to serve him.

result.reason: The passage explicitly states Gaal’s desire for the people to be under his authority, matching the key.
